{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches CBlockIndex member annotations and block index reading in RPCs; does not touch mempool data structures, policy, or transaction acceptance.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not affect mempool or transaction relay policy."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp` and `src/rpc/blockchain.h` to hold `cs_main` when reading `CBlockIndex` fields in `getblockheader`, `getchaintxstats`, and `dumptxoutset`.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes data races in blockchain RPC handlers reading `CBlockIndex` fields without holding `cs_main`. Adding `cs_main` to these RPC methods impacts locking behavior and avoids undefined behavior under concurrent block downloads or AssumeUTXO syncing."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Annotates `CBlockIndex::nTx` and `m_chain_tx_count` in `src/chain.h` with `GUARDED_BY(cs_main)` and fixes unsynchronized accesses in `src/validation.cpp` and callers.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.55,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a verified TSan data race on block index state between background syncing and external readers. Reviewers confirmed the race reproduces under AssumeUTXO and pruned-node redownloads, making proper synchronization of `CBlockIndex` state important for validation stability."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}

categories.evidence: Annotates `CBlockIndex::nTx` and `m_chain_tx_count` in `src/chain.h` with `GUARDED_BY(cs_main)` and fixes unsynchronized accesses in `src/validation.cpp` and callers.
